title: Occult history in NASA and launch pad choices

tellings.quote: There's a lot of occult history, occult history in NASA. Some of the the nomenclature that was used for certain missions and and the choosing of, you know, launch pad 33 and some other things were very deliberate.

plain: NASA has a lot of occult history, says a guest on the show, and some of the names given to missions, along with the choice of launch pad 33 and other things, were made very deliberately. The speaker, who is not named, passes this on from what someone else told them and gives no specific examples. If true, it would mean mystical ideas quietly shaped choices inside the space agency.
